what: DATA-D3a values for records that live in lane files this batch does not own (R2a.json, R1.json, the capture migrated.json files, the web seed). One record per ref across a trip's lane files (E_SUIT_DUP_REF, E_CAP_DUP_REF), so these cannot go into TF.json. Each entry names the file, the ref, the dot path and the Val to write, with sources read on 25 Oct 2026. Apply with the file's own source ids (add a source row where the URL is new) and run node core/bin/suitability.ts derive --write after.

code_requests.finding: The second Tre Cime line is OSM relation 1657833 (path 104). It comes from the seed fact geometry_ids "paths 101 (rel 1116663, 8.5 km) and 104 (rel 1657833, 4 km) are nearby" (data/seed/prototype/trails.ts line 244), which buildLines in web/lib/public/places.ts turns into one line per id. withTrack (web/lib/public/tracks.ts lines 68-70) then marks every extra line exportable when the stored track is confirmed and stitched, although that line has no geometry. Two fixes, either is enough: (a) in withTrack, exportable for the extra lines also needs their own geometry (l.geometry?.length); (b) take '104 (rel 1657833, 4 km)' out of the seed text, since the stored track (relations 1116663 and 1067603) is the loop. (a) also covers any other trail with a stale id. A data-only batch cannot make either change.

Larch Valley: already done. The world/national draw sits on part/legacy/canadian-rockies-sept-2029/trails/larch-valley-sentinel-pass#sentinel-pass (R2a relevance, v national) and the route has no relevance record, so nothing is left to move. Tre Cime: the route place/tre-cime-di-lavaredo-loop holds draw world in data/relevance/dolomites-2027/R1.json, and neither payoff part (#tre-cime, #north-face-viewpoint) has a relevance record. Moving it needs a new relevance record for each part (a relevance lane file, which no DATA batch owns) and, if the route's world value is a pre-migration ledger leaf, a supersede entry lowering the route's draw (data/capture/supersedes.json, also not a D3a file). Decision for the coordinator: which lane writes the two part records, and whether the route keeps world (route_is_attraction is still true).
